attr.title: Mass Effect Infiltrator
attr.desc: The 2011 Mass Effect Infiltrator mobile third-person action game by IronMonkey Studios, running its original Android ARM library directly on Linux through a bionic/JNI compatibility loader.
attr.inst: Supply your own Mass Effect Infiltrator v1.0.58 gamepad-build APK, ZIP, or extracted folder. Put it in ports/masseffect/; the donor filename does not matter and the first launch extracts and validates it automatically. Keep the port release named masseffect-portmaster.zip. Wait for PortMaster's Finished running autoinstall dialog, then reboot normally before looking for the game in Ports. The supported native-library SHA1 is ea58b733d3d267ab639431b50539542faa43f0d0. No game data is included.
